context: Two news editors plan a local-politics segment
purpose: Teach: 議決/選出/諮問/選任/合法/反し/不利/地方自治体

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 今度の地方自治体に関する特集なんですが、市議会の議決の流れを中心に追いたいんですよね。
lines.en: For the upcoming feature on local governments, I'd like to focus on how the city council's resolutions move forward.
lines.style: Polite junior pitching an angle to a senior editor

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 悪くないけど、議員の選出方法そのものに踏み込まないと、視聴者には伝わりづらいと思うよ。
lines.en: Not bad, but unless we dig into how the council members themselves are chosen, viewers won't really get it.
lines.style: Senior editor giving constructive pushback in calm tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: じゃあ、市長の諮問機関のメンバー選任のプロセスもセットで扱うのはどうでしょう。
lines.en: Then how about packaging it with the selection process for members of the mayor's advisory body too?
lines.style: Eager pitch with rising enthusiasm and respectful tone

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: それは面白い。手続き自体は完全に合法でも、慣例に反して特定の業界寄りの人ばかり並ぶケースもあるからね。
lines.en: That's interesting. Even when the procedure itself is fully legal, sometimes it bends custom by stacking the panel with industry insiders.
lines.style: Thoughtful editor weighing journalistic angles aloud

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうなんです。結局そこら辺の不透明さが、住民にとっては一番不利に働くわけで。
lines.en: Exactly. In the end that kind of opaqueness is what hurts residents the most.
lines.style: Earnest reporter pressing his point with conviction

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: よし、来週までに諮問委員会の名簿と過去の議決記録をそろえておいて。
lines.en: Alright, by next week pull together the advisory committee roster and the past resolution records.
lines.style: Decisive editor assigning concrete next steps clearly

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 了解です。ついでに他の地方自治体の選任基準とも比較できる資料を作っておきます。
lines.en: Got it. I'll also prepare materials comparing the appointment standards used by other local governments.
lines.style: Reliable junior confirming assignment with added initiative
